title: Priority Given on a Membership and Patronage Equity Revolvement Where the Cooperative Has Been Notified of a Death
content:
A membership the cooperative has been notified is closing is moved up the queue, since the family cannot wait on a cycle.

**Where an approved application stands.** Where notice of death stands recorded on the membership and a signed estate application stands registered and approved, the pool share is doubled, that is taken at 2 times itself.

**Where notice stands alone.** Where notice of death stands recorded and no signed estate application stands registered and approved, it is taken at 1.5 times itself.

**Otherwise.** It is taken as worked out.

## The three readings on hypothetical records

| Notice of death recorded on the membership | Signed estate application registered and approved | The pool share is taken at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | 2 times itself |
| yes | none registered | 1.5 times itself |
| yes | registered but not approved | 1.5 times itself |
| yes | approved but not signed by the member's estate | 1.5 times itself |
| no | yes | as worked out |

**On the second reading in its three forms.** All three limbs must hold together for the first reading: the application must stand registered as an estate retirement application, it must stand approved, and it must be signed. Failing any one of them, and with notice of death recorded, the second reading is the one that holds.

**Worked.** A pool share of 1050.00 becomes 2100.00 on the first reading and 1575.00 on the second, the figure being rounded to two decimal places. This weighting is what Membership and Patronage Equity applies before the dividend is added.
